source: FACMA, 'Precios Orientativos: Embolsado y Extracción' (31 Aug 2026, p. 1); Olivanti (2012) citing INTA Balcarce/Manfredi (p. 2); Cámaras Arbitrales de Cereales, 'Reglas y Usos del Comercio de Granos' (2016, Art. 43, p. 15); Iowa State University Ag Decision Maker File A2-33 (rev. May 2023, pp. 1-2)
reason: Silo-bag contractor service cost (FACMA p. 1) excludes polyethylene bag film purchase; Argentine own-silo variable costs and commercial acopio monthly USD/t tariffs lack a public 2026 national schedule.

own_silo.source: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Ag Decision Maker File A2-33, 'Cost of Storing Grain' (FM 1816, rev. May 2023, pp. 1-2: existing bin ownership costs sunk; extra handling 2.0-2.5 c/bu midpoint 2.25 c/bu * 39.368 bu/t = 0.89 USD/t; aeration electricity 0.2-0.3 c/bu midpoint 0.25 c/bu over ~6 months = 0.02 USD/t/month; handling and storage shrinkage 0.5-1% midpoint 0.75%)
own_silo.reason: No public 2026 INTA/MAGyP schedule for on-farm metal silo variable aeration/handling costs in USD/t; provisional physical midpoints taken from ISU File A2-33 (pp. 1-2).

silo_bag.source: FACMA, 'Precios Orientativos: Embolsado y Extracción' (31 Aug 2026, p. 1 table: Embolsado 3.95 + Extracción 3.95 + Tolva autodescargable 3.39 = Total 11.30 USD/t at 1,503 ARS/USD); Olivanti (2012), 'Almacenamiento de granos en bolsas plásticas' citing INTA Balcarce/Manfredi (p. 2 table: 6 months low-risk horizon for dry grain <=14% moisture, zero biological weight loss)
silo_bag.reason: FACMA (p. 1) covers the machinery contracting service (11.30 USD/t) and excludes the polyethylene bag purchase cost; Olivanti/INTA (p. 2) does not quantify mechanical extraction loss.

elevator.source: Cámaras Arbitrales de Cereales (BCR, BCCBA, Bahía Blanca, Buenos Aires), 'Reglas y Usos del Comercio de Granos' (2016, Art. 43, p. 15: conservation expenses and storage shrink/risks are covered within the agreed storage tariff)
elevator.reason: Art. 43 (p. 15) confirms zero storage shrink charged separately to the depositor, but commercial acopio monthly USD/t tariffs are negotiated locally per cooperative/elevator rather than fixed in a public national Cámara table; retains the legacy 2.0 USD/t/month provisional rate.
